_comment: Single source of truth for monokernel shapes. Each entry declares ONE compile-time specialization (the kernel is template-specialized on N/K/E, so a new shape needs a rebuild). The generator csrc/fused_moe/monomoe/tools/gen_shapes.py reads this and emits the C++ Dims structs (dims_generated.inc). Shape-keyed names are E{E}_N{N}_K{K} and carry no model name. config[0] MUST be the shipped default (its knobs define the base Dims). UP_COL_HALVES is normally DERIVED from DCT: uch = max(1, 2*N*DCT/(128*K)); uch>=2 => raw two-TMA up-proj (no Python interleave). A shape MAY instead pin UP_COL_HALVES explicitly (optional per-shape 'up_col_halves' field) to DECOUPLE the up grid from the down grid when the coupling identity has no integer solution (UP_GROUPS != DOWN_GROUPS); such shapes use the expert-slot producer->consumer split at site #2 and are all-raw (never interleaved). top_k is a RUNTIME arg (1..8); the value here is only the tuner/serving default.

configs.note: UCH=2 raw (no interleave); DCT=512 exceeds the BS16 SHM budget, so this config is BS8-only
UCH=2 raw, KUP=128; DCT=512 exceeds the BS16 SHM budget, so this config is BS8-only
BS16-safe decoupled/raw candidate: UCH=2 with DCT=256 to stay within SHM budget
config-0 up side + 4-deep down TMA ring (KDN=128, DPD=4): 2 K-steps of down lookahead to keep DRAM busy through the per-expert epilogue
default (KUP=256, 188KB); fastest on H200 BS8 M=1..8

shapes._comment: DECOUPLED up/down carve. K=6144, N_half=256 has no coupled solution (the identity 2N/(128*UCH)=K/DCT forces DOWN_COL_TILE=1536 => 12 halves / ~384KB SHM). Pin UP_COL_HALVES=2 explicitly (raw two-TMA up-proj, NO Python interleave) so the up grid (UP_GRID=2*N/(128*UCH)=2, UP_GROUPS=64) is chosen independently of the down grid (DOWN_GRID=K/DCT=16, DOWN_GROUPS=8). Barrier ratio R=UP_GROUPS/DOWN_GROUPS=8; site #2 uses the expert-slot producer->consumer split (expert_produce_arrive / expert_consume_wait) instead of the coupled per-up_group expert_barrier. down-proj reduction dim is N=256 (K_TILES_DOWN = 256/KDN). All configs are raw (UCH>=2) so Python never interleaves w13.
